recommendationPreference: Personal agents, consumer use before enterprise use. Prioritize concrete product updates, memory/context, voice and multimodal interaction, planning and execution, tool/app connections, cross-device experience, privacy, permissions, reliability and supporting model capabilities. Downrank pure robotics, industrial automation, networking and infrastructure unless they directly improve personal-agent experiences. Exclude financing-only news, promotions and generic technology news. Recommend fewer or none when evidence is insufficient.
